_note: One block per workflow. No secrets here: this file is committed. Key *ids* live in gemini-pools.json; key values never leave the ignored key file.

jephter.description: A private publishing tool that writes, narrates and uploads short videos to one YouTube channel that its owner has authorised.

script.theme: how it feels to be loved, and how it feels to love someone back
script.focus: expressive and mindful. Notice the small sensations — warmth, breath, weight, light, the sound of the room. Stay inside the feeling rather than describing the event. The listener should recognise a feeling they have had, not watch a scene.
script.avoid: advice, lessons, instructions, moralising, 'you should', 'remember to', any second half that explains the first

voice.name: Leda
voice.cue: [speaking slowly and softly, almost in a whisper]
voice.audition_note: Chosen 2026-10-27 from 10 candidates on one 17-word line: Leda is the quietest read (-29.5 dB mean) at 2.66 words/s. Callirrhoe (-23.9 dB) and Sulafat (-20.7 dB) are noticeably more projected. Despina is slower (1.49 w/s) but too slow: an 85-word script would take ~57 s and break the 50 s cap.

emmanuel.description: A private publishing tool that writes, narrates and uploads short videos to one YouTube channel that its owner has authorised.

script.theme: how to love someone intentionally, unconditionally, and unapologetically
script.focus: devotional and deliberate. Show love as a choice made on purpose — staying, choosing again, tenderness that does not ask for anything back. Quiet conviction, no speeches, no lists of advice. The listener should feel capable of loving like that.
script.avoid: platitudes, bullet points, therapy vocabulary, 'communication is key', anything that sounds like a lecture or a listicle

voice.name: Leda
voice.cue: [speaking slowly and softly, almost in a whisper]
voice.audition_note: Changed 2026-11-01: the owner asked for "the current forchi's voice", and on the same day asked that ForChi's Shorts use the voice they love from jephter — Leda. Both channels now share Leda, which is a deliberate reversal of the earlier 'voices must differ' rule and was the owner's explicit call. Umbriel (pause-profile gap 0.002 from Leda) remains the closest distinct alternative if the channels ever need to diverge again; it is a one-word change here.
